name: unienv
description: Use your computer's always-ready document, PDF, OCR and data tools from Claude: read, create and convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files locally.
long_description: UniEnv AI gives every AI tool on your computer one shared, pre-installed environment (python-docx, openpyxl, python-pptx, pandas, pypdf, pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, tesseract and more). This extension connects Claude Desktop to it, so chat can read local documents, create and edit Office files, convert formats and run Python with those packages, without installing anything per task. Requires UniEnv to be installed: https://github.com/rupeshbharambe24/unienv-ai

tools.name: unienv_capabilities
tools.description: List the pre-installed tools and packages, with usage notes

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, HTML or image (OCR) files as text

tools.name: convert_document
tools.description: Convert documents, e.g. docx → pdf, md → docx, pdf → txt/png

tools.name: run_python
tools.description: Run Python with python-docx, openpyxl, python-pptx, pandas, matplotlib and more

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run pandoc, LibreOffice, Poppler, qpdf, tesseract and other UniEnv tools

tools.name: install_package
tools.description: Permanently add a missing package for every AI tool

workdir.title: Output folder
workdir.description: Where new files go when Claude doesn't give a path.

mode.title: MCP mode
mode.description: Use full for all tools or readonly for reading and conversion only. Readonly conversions write next to the source or into the output folder.

allow_install.title: Allow package installation
allow_install.description: Permit install_package in full mode when no folder restrictions are configured.

roots.title: Allowed folders
roots.description: Colon-separated absolute folders or ~/ paths, for example ~/Documents:~/UniEnv. Empty means unrestricted. Setting folders disables code execution, command execution, and installation.
